title: Continuation checklist
summary: Continue the cluster-object-memory line without collapsing authority boundaries or promoting local transport tests to field readiness.
invariants: Check Library and Git heads before binding to Memory Fabric, Queue Fabric or XTP APIs.
Do not move payload to the runner by default; move execution to resident data.
Do not let Queue Fabric transport success replace durable receiver UOW evidence.
Do not let XTP local protection tests imply MU/MI FIELD_PASS.
Do not release the source object on an uncertain request or reply.
Keep placement authority in Job-to-Node and route readiness in an injected authoritative gate.
Update this sphere whenever the selected XTP route evidence, durable receipt protocol or Memory Fabric fencing contract changes.
